dsh-voice-enhance README · dsh-voice-enhance：Voice dictation and prompt enhancement for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`) — two controls added to the message composer.

[中文说明](README.zh.md)

dsh-voice-enhance README · What it does：**Hold Alt to dictate.** Press and hold `Alt`, speak, release. The recording is transcribed on the Host and then cleaned up — typos, homophones, missing characters, punctuation and sentence breaks — and the result is inserted at the cursor. The cleanup is deliberately minimal: it never rewrites, expands, summarises or asks a question, and anything uncertain is left exactly as it came out. A dictated sentence that happens to *sound* like an instruction is treated as text to be copied, not as a request to follow.

dsh-voice-enhance README · What it does：**✨ Enhance prompt.** The sparkle button at the left of the composer, immediately before the model selector, rewrites the current draft into a brief an assistant can act on without asking follow-up questions: it supplies the background and goal, splits the request into separately checkable task points, states acceptance per point, and fixes the scope, constraints and deliverable format. The result replaces the draft, with an Undo control to get the original back.

dsh-voice-enhance README · What it does：**Restore draft.** Enhancing replaces the whole draft, so only enhancement records draft history; dictation just fixes homophones and punctuation without rewriting what you said, so it never enters the history. Restore either with the "Restore draft" button on the status pill, or by pressing `R` while the focus is **not** in a text field (inside the composer, R keeps typing the letter). The history is kept per Session in browser storage, survives a reload and holds up to 12 drafts; a restore is itself undoable, so the text currently in the box is never lost. The pill also keeps the restore affordance visible once a draft is stored — dictating again will not hide it.

dsh-voice-enhance README · What it does：A status pill appears below the composer card while either control is working: elapsed seconds, a "send on release" switch, an Insert button when a transcript could not be placed, and an Undo button after an enhancement.

dsh-voice-enhance README · What it does：| Key / control | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| `Alt` (press and hold) | Start recording |
| release `Alt` | Stop, transcribe, correct, insert |
| `Alt` + any other key | Treated as a shortcut (`Alt+Tab` is caught by the OS); the capture is discarded |
| `Esc` while recording | Cancel |
| ✨ button | Enhance the draft |
| `Ctrl+.` | Restore the previous draft |

dsh-voice-enhance README · Requirements：- The recording is transcribed by the Harness **Voice Input** plugin (`dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle`), which must be enabled and its SenseVoice model prepared. Without it the plugin reports that the speech service is unavailable.
- Correction and prompt enhancement run on the Host through the `llm` service. Correction always uses the composition's **default model route**; prompt enhancement follows the **model picked on the plugin page** (default: the current route, freely selectable from every installed model). No API key is configured or read by this plugin.
- The browser needs microphone access (HTTPS or `127.0.0.1`, plus OS permission).

dsh-voice-enhance README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:Chrono-rigger/dsh-voice-enhance
```

Or from the Web UI: **Settings → Plugins**, then install the bundle by package name or from a local directory.

dsh-voice-enhance README · Notes：- Two Remote calls cross the wire, both of them one-shot text rewrites: `promptTools/refine` with `mode: "correct"` for a transcript, `mode: "enhance"` for a draft; the enhance request may carry an `enhanceRoute` picked on the plugin page.
- Nothing is persisted except three browser-local preferences: the "send on release" switch (`dsh-voice-enhance.autoSend`), the custom keys (`dsh-voice-enhance.keys`) and the enhancement model route (`dsh-voice-enhance.enhanceRoute`). Recordings are discarded after transcription; no audio is written to disk.

dsh-voice-enhance 为 DSH Web 输入框加入语音输入和提示词编辑。它在对话编辑器中注册按钮及状态区域。按住快捷键说话、松开后，调用已启用的 Voice Input 转写语音，再由 Host LLM 修正文字并插入光标处；也可点击✨把草稿整理成目标、任务和验收标准更清楚的提示词，并恢复先前草稿。语音修正跟随默认模型，提示词增强可选择模型。需要麦克风权限及 Voice Input 插件和语音模型。

dsh-voice-enhance adds dictation and prompt editing to the DSH web composer. Hold a shortcut to record; Voice Input transcribes speech and the Host LLM corrects it for insertion. A sparkle button clarifies drafts into goals and tasks. Microphone permission and the Voice Input plugin are required.
想在 DSH 对话框里按住快捷键说话，把识别后的文字直接插入输入框。
有没有办法把写得很粗略的提示词整理成更清楚、可执行的任务？
I want to dictate into the DSH composer and have the transcript cleaned up before it is inserted.
dsh-voice-enhance 的功能「语音输入与校正」：在对话输入框按住配置的快捷键录音，松开后调用 Voice Input 转写，并由 Host LLM 修正明显错字、标点和断句，再插入光标处；无法接受修正时保留原转写。
dsh-voice-enhance 的功能「提示词增强」：点击输入框旁的✨按钮，将当前草稿改写为目标、任务要点、验收方式、范围和交付物更明确的提示词，并提供恢复先前草稿的操作。
dsh-voice-enhance 会将语音转写结果或当前提示词草稿通过 Host 的 LLM 服务处理；语音转写另调用已启用的 Voice Input 服务，插件本身不读取 API Key。
